generation_strategy: IMAGEN COMBINADA 1536×1024: skin body (izquierda) + cañón temático (derecha).

frames.role: Cuerpo del tanque skin Chrome (plata/premium) — skin rara
frames.prompt:
TWO cartoon tank sprites side by side on a 1536x1024 transparent canvas. Both viewed strictly from directly above at 90 degrees (bird's eye zenith view, only TOP SURFACE visible). STYLE: vibrant premium cartoon art, Brawl Stars quality, bold dark charcoal outlines, smooth cel-shading gradients.

LEFT PANEL — CHROME TANK BODY (silver/premium rare skin): Bright silver (#DDDDEE) tank body. The roof surface has: clean geometric panel lines with precise edges, circular turret ring with a polished look, armored hatch with cool metallic detail, very clean and precise geometric surface — premium and sleek. TWO SEGMENTED TRACK STRIPS on left/right edges (dark cool-gray with metallic sheen on individual links). Cel-shading: bright white specular highlight (large prominent area), cool silver-blue mid-tone, dark cool blue-gray shadow. Clean, premium, no grime. Chunky squat proportions.

RIGHT PANEL — CHROME CANNON (matching silver theme): Narrow elongated rectangle pointing UP, base wider. Bright silver (#CCCCDD) with white specular highlight stripe. Cool metallic aesthetic. Bold charcoal outline.

Strictly top-down. NO front/side face. NO background, NO text.
frames.negative_prompt: realistic chrome reflections, ray tracing, pixel art, military realism, warm orange/red colors, rust, dirt, worn, photorealistic, text, watermark, background scenery
